metadata.collision_scope: source shell with explicitly substituted analytic through-guide/rims; not mesh-exact installedmodel

model_assumptions.authority: Configurable CAD/manual-informed retractor instance, not a reconstructed certified internal mechanism
model_assumptions.upper_surface_material_clamp: explicit approximation; first finite rod prescribed, upper62mm connector omitted
model_assumptions.hidden_rear_axis: explicit candidate material continuity to H; no port node fixed
model_assumptions.H: assumed material clamp with orientation locked by native SliderJoint and TranslationOnlyBody, plus one bare-slider mass; not a freely sliding/rotating material point and not verified manufacturer carriage identity
model_assumptions.front_length: explicit caller parameter; verify applicable drawing endpoints/variant separately
model_assumptions.initial_front: new3arc length-matched reference, not old72curve or per-frame animation
model_assumptions.outer_radius: 41mm measured U skin; uniform downstream41mm is assumed, DN70 is inside diameter only
model_assumptions.stiffness: effective EI/GJ, rho and all spring/rail/impedance values uncalibrated
model_assumptions.swivel: ideal axial retention with rotational/pendulum freedom; bearing and internal bundle resistance separately configurable
model_assumptions.material_reference: straight natural hypothesis by default; initial_stress_free is a distinct comparison
conditional_manual_warnings: 150mm dynamic bend comparison conditional on article association; overbend is reported, not projected away
basicmanual pp36–37 max axial stretch/compression1%; red extension mark=endtravel, yellow usuallynotexceeded
only rotary protectors may directly contact robot; missing protector placement prevents installed contact acceptance
light pretension and slight A6 tension stated qualitatively; numerical limits absent
